title: Receive goods
description: The storekeeper records goods received at a place; issuing starts the Post task; a tenant administrator (the approver, StockApprove) completes it; the balance of the item at the place rises. A stuck posting start can be retried.
preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
refusals: a role without StockPost is refused 403; an API token or scoped principal gets the uniform 404
an issue check failure is 422 with a reason (for example event time outside the 96-hour window, inactive master)
a second completion of the same post task writes nothing (one posted mark per document)

tasks.result: a draft receipt (lines with item, unit, quantity, optional lot, price, supplier document, received-on date)
the issue checks run (master data, event-time window); the document is fixed (state issued) and the stock_receipt instance is started with a Post task addressed to the tenant administrator role label
the administrator claims and completes the Post task (StockApprove); the document is posted and one ledger entry is written
the document reads posted with its entry id

title: Issue goods
description: The storekeeper issues goods out of a place; after the Post task the balance falls. Whether a balance may go below zero is the tenant's negative-balance setting (default refuse).
preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
enough stock at the place, or the tenant negative-balance setting set to allow
refusals: a role without StockPost is refused 403; an API token or scoped principal gets the uniform 404
an issue check failure is 422 with a reason (for example event time outside the 96-hour window, inactive master)
a second completion of the same post task writes nothing (one posted mark per document)
a posting that would take the balance below zero is refused `insufficient_stock` unless the tenant allows negative balances (the post task stays pending)

tasks.result: a draft issue document with a number-less draft id (state draft)
the issue checks run (master data, event-time window); the document is fixed (state issued) and the stock_issue instance is started with a Post task addressed to the tenant administrator role label
the administrator claims and completes the Post task (StockApprove); the document is posted and one ledger entry is written
the document reads posted with its entry id

preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
refusals: a role without StockPost is refused 403; an API token or scoped principal gets the uniform 404
an issue check failure is 422 with a reason (for example event time outside the 96-hour window, inactive master)
a second completion of the same post task writes nothing (one posted mark per document)
a write-off without a valid reason code is refused 422

tasks.result: a draft write_off document with a number-less draft id (state draft)

the issue checks run (master data, event-time window); the document is fixed (state issued) and the stock_writeoff instance is started with a Post task addressed to the tenant administrator role label
the administrator claims and completes the Post task (StockApprove); the document is posted and one ledger entry is written
the document reads posted with its entry id

title: Transfer between places
description: The storekeeper moves goods from one place (or org unit, or responsible) to another; one document, one ledger entry with two legs per line, minus at the from side and plus at the to side.
preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
refusals: a role without StockPost is refused 403; an API token or scoped principal gets the uniform 404
an issue check failure is 422 with a reason (for example event time outside the 96-hour window, inactive master)
a second completion of the same post task writes nothing (one posted mark per document)
a transfer whose to side equals its from side is refused 422

tasks.result: a draft transfer document with a number-less draft id (state draft)

the issue checks run (master data, event-time window); the document is fixed (state issued) and the stock_transfer instance is started with a Post task addressed to the tenant administrator role label
the administrator claims and completes the Post task (StockApprove); the document is posted and one ledger entry is written
the document reads posted with its entry id

preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
refusals: a role without StockPost is refused 403; an API token or scoped principal gets the uniform 404
an issue check failure is 422 with a reason (for example event time outside the 96-hour window, inactive master)
a second completion of the same post task writes nothing (one posted mark per document)
a hand over whose to side equals its from side is refused 422

tasks.result: a draft hand_over document with a number-less draft id (state draft)

the issue checks run (master data, event-time window); the document is fixed (state issued) and the stock_handover instance is started with a Post task addressed to the tenant administrator role label
the administrator claims and completes the Post task (StockApprove); the document is posted and one ledger entry is written
the document reads posted with its entry id

title: Return goods
description: Stock goes back from the returning org unit, place and responsible person to the org unit that files the document (own document type RET); two legs per line, minus at the from side and plus at the to side.
preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
refusals: a role without StockPost is refused 403; an API token or scoped principal gets the uniform 404
an issue check failure is 422 with a reason (for example event time outside the 96-hour window, inactive master)
a second completion of the same post task writes nothing (one posted mark per document)

tasks.result: a draft return document with a number-less draft id (state draft)
the issue checks run (master data, event-time window); the document is fixed (state issued) and the stock_return instance is started with a Post task addressed to the tenant administrator role label
the administrator claims and completes the Post task (StockApprove); the document is posted and one ledger entry is written

title: Opening balances
description: Initial stock enters the ledger with an opening document (positive lines, or all-negative lines when the tenant allows negative balances). One person prepares (submit task), a different person approves (approve task, StockApprove); the check route shows every line's reasons without writing anything. Lines can also be loaded from an xlsx as a draft.
preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
the approval rule of stock_opening/approve (four-eyes) is the tenant's choice: ON means a different person must approve
refusals: the approver equal to the preparer is refused while the four-eyes rule is ON (SeparationOfDuties)
a document mixing positive and negative lines is refused; a negative line is accepted only while the tenant allows negative balances
a client event time on an opening is refused (the entry's time is its posting time)

tasks.result: a draft opening document with lines (location, responsible, real receipt date, quantity)
every line's reasons; nothing is written (no number, no entry)
the checks run at issue; the document is issued and the stock_opening instance starts with a submit task
the preparer completes the submit task (no write)
a different person (distinct_from submit) with StockApprove completes approve; the opening is posted at its posting time

title: Quick count of one item at one place
description: The counter types the counted quantity (zero allowed) of one item at one place; the system stores book quantity and difference, issues the document and starts the quick-count process: submit by the counter, approve by another person (four-eyes ON) or by the system itself when the tenant's count rule is OFF. The balance becomes the counted quantity; a count equal to the book posts nothing and reads confirmed.
preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
the approval rule stock_quick_count/approve is ON (a different person approves) or stored OFF (self-approval by the system, the actor stays the counter)
no opened count order covers the key
refusals: four-eyes ON: the counter cannot approve their own count
rule OFF: only an interactive sign-in's own newest count is self-approved; an API token or another user's count is never approved this way
count_in_progress (422) while an opened count order covers the key; location_frozen at approval
a role without StockQuickCount is refused 403

tasks.result: book quantity read under the caller's read authority, difference stored, document issued; refusal count_in_progress when an opened count order covers the key
the counter's own submit step
approve posts cause count_set (one leg = the difference); a key that moved since is refused balance_changed (stock alias quick_count_stale)

title: Count order: issue, count on the sheet, close
description: A manager creates a count order (header, places, commission members), issues it, a commission member opens it at a cut-off (book quantities are read from the ledger), types or scans counted quantities, adds surplus lines and closes it, which issues the count sheet. A freeze mode holds other postings on the counted places while the count is open.
preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
the places of the order are linked to its org unit and do not overlap another open order
commission members are active employees
refusals: not_commission_member, count_not_due, lines_uncounted, count_scope_overlaps, count_window_expired (422 with reason)
opening needs a tenant-wide reader; any other principal gets 404
a role without StockCountOrder cannot create or issue; without StockCountRecord cannot open or count

tasks.result: a draft count order (whole-document replace of header, location_ids, member_employee_ids)
the order is issued (count.order document, fixed)
the count opens at the cut-off; book quantities from the ledger; with the freeze mode the counted pairs refuse other postings (location_frozen)
counted quantity per line, surplus lines added, append-only entry log
a scanner code adds one unit to its line (scan_id counted once) or selects a location
all lines counted; the count sheet document is issued; the order reads counted
an order not yet posted can be cancelled and releases its freeze

title: Count: sign the sheet, differences, sign, post
description: After the sheet is closed the chair records the sheet signers, issues the differences sheet, records its signers (the count becomes signed), a person with StockPost starts the posting and a tenant administrator completes the Post task; one ledger entry holds one leg per difference (counted minus book at the cut-off). The posting record closes the count as posted.
preconditions: a closed (counted) count order
the signing person is the chair of the commission
refusals: not_chair, signers_incomplete, sheet_already_signed, sheet_not_signed, differences_already_issued, no_differences (422)
posting_pending, count_posted, definition_not_active (409)
shortage_exceeds_balance while the tenant refuses negative balances

tasks.result: sheet signed, differences document issued, differences signed; the order reads signed
the posting instance (stock_count_posting) starts
the administrator completes Post: one ledger entry (cause count_difference, delta counted minus book); a freeze order's own posting is exempt from its freeze
the count order reads posted

title: Count paperwork and print forms
description: The issued count documents leave the system as xlsx or PDF: order, sheet, differences, the field worksheet with empty boxes, and the official forms Inv-10 and Inv-18.
preconditions: an issued count order
refusals: an unknown kind or lang is refused 422; a document not yet issued is refused; a caller who may not read the order gets 404

tasks.result: an .xlsx or PDF (lang ru, kk or en; form inv10 or inv18) of the issued document; worksheet only for an ordered or counting order; nothing is written

title: Reverse a posted document or cancel an issued one
description: A posted document (or a posted count) is reversed with a reason: a reversal task is started and a tenant administrator completes it; the ledger negates the original legs and the balance returns. An issued document that is not posted yet is cancelled. A document is reversed once; a reversal is not reversed.
preconditions: a posted document (to reverse) or an issued document (to cancel)
refusals: document_not_posted, document_reversed, reversal_pending, posting_inconsistent (409)
reason_required / reason_invalid / reason_too_long (422)
the reversed balance may not go below zero unless the tenant allows it

tasks.result: the reversal instance starts (state reversal_pending) with a Reverse task
the administrator completes Reverse; the ledger entry is negated; the document reads reversed
an issued, unposted document becomes cancelled
a posted count is reversed through the same stock_reversal process (reason_code and reason_text required)

title: Excel balances workbook: export, check, apply, cancel
description: The administrator downloads the whole current stock in the Qoimeks workbook layout, edits quantities, checks the file (per-row remarks and the changes it would make, nothing written), applies it (a quick-count document with one line per change, approved through the quick-count process), lists the last loads and cancels or reverses one.
preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
a workbook of at most 2 MiB in the Qoimeks layout
no opened count order covers a changed key
refusals: apply by a role without StockWorkbookApply (the storekeeper) is 403
too_many_changes over 1000 lines; count_in_progress (422)
reason_required / reason_too_long on cancel; import_already_cancelled; reversal_pending (409)
a body over 2 MiB or not an xlsx is refused

tasks.result: the whole current stock as one .xlsx, no query key, nothing written
per-row Russian remarks and the changes a load would make against one org unit; writes no record, entry or number
201 with document_id, number, lines, remarks and approve_task_id; 200 applied false when nothing changes
the load's approve task posts the changes (or the system self-approves with the rule OFF)
the last 50 loads, newest first, with state and reversal_pending
an issued load is cancelled; a posted load starts a reversal (reverse_pending)

title: Find, correct and discard a draft document
description: Before issuing, the storekeeper lists documents, reopens a draft, replaces it as a whole or discards it. An issued document is fixed.
preconditions: module stock installed (all stock process definitions ACTIVE)
item, unit, place (linked to the org unit), org unit and responsible employee exist and are active
the caller is an interactive, tenant-wide sign-in (an API token or a scoped user gets 404)
refusals: document_not_draft (409) when the document is issued or posted
an unknown or other tenant's id is 404

tasks.result: a page of documents with next_cursor
the whole draft is replaced (every loaded value must be sent back)
the draft is discarded (204)

title: Balances, movements, stock card and official stock forms
description: Anyone with StockRead sees balances (also as of a past day), the movement journal, the stock card of one item at one place (form Z-3) and the stock sheet of one place and period (form Z-7); an issued document prints as an act or as official forms Z-1, Z-2, Z-5 or Z-6. The administrator can reconcile the ledger and read the posting settings and approval access.
preconditions: module stock installed
for an as-of balance the date is not in the future
refusals: a tenant key in the query is 422 invalid_filter and never read
cutoff_in_future, as_of_date_in_future, invalid_timezone (422); reconcile_busy (409); ledger_read_timeout (503)
reconcile for a role without StockReconcile (the storekeeper) is refused

tasks.result: balances with filters (item, place, org unit, responsible, lot), as_of_date, scope_subtree; format xlsx on request
the movement journal with filters and cursor; hidden legs of a scoped reader are masked
PDF or DOCX of the stock card (Z-3), stock sheet (Z-7) and of an issued document (Z-1, Z-2, Z-5, Z-6)
negative_balance allowed or refused; whether the caller holds StockApprove (writes nothing)
ledger mismatches, gap, chain and audit checks of the stock ledger

title: Old-app (Qoimeks address) phone operations
description: A shop-floor phone uses the per-tenant address /qoimeks/<slug> with a shared-access value: it reads the catalog, balances and movements, looks up a scanned code, posts receipt, issue, transfer or a count (kind adjustment) in the old app's shape and reverses a movement. Every write carries an operator name and a client operation id: a repeat of the same id and data returns the stored row, changed data is refused.

actors.permission: shared stock access credential of the tenant
creates and revokes the shared access

preconditions: the tenant slug is listed in the deployment setting and the stock module installed
a shared access is active for the tenant
tenant scope enforcement is off
the place is linked to an org unit and an active employee exists
refusals: every authentication failure is the same 401 with no tenant-dependent detail; the address's failures spend a rate-limit token (429 when empty)
the tenant's scope enforcement on or shadow answers 403 scope_enforcement_active
operator missing or over 200 characters, id missing or not a UUID, body over 8192 bytes: 400/413 and nothing written
any other path or method is 404

tasks.result: the old app's JSON shapes; non-zero balances; movements newest first
201 one movement of the posted document with balances after; 200 the stored row on a repeat of the same id and data; 409 same id with other data
201 the reversal's own movement; 400 already reversed / reversal cannot be reversed / quantity must be positive

title: Voice or typed draft of a document
description: The storekeeper speaks (or types) a phrase; the system turns it into a server-checked draft of a document from the caller's own active items and places. Nothing is stored; the person confirms and creates the document normally. The old app's microphone call does the same on its own address.

actors.permission: shared stock access credential of the tenant

preconditions: speech and model providers configured (otherwise 503 speech_off / notice llm_off)
refusals: audio over 10 MB is 413 audio_too_large; a format other than m4a or WebM is 415 audio_format
bad_language, field_invalid, field_not_allowed (422)
provider failure 502/504; speech off 503

tasks.result: a draft (kind, items, location, quantity, transcript); read only
the same draft on the old address (only the /api form is served)

title: Stock side of the change of kind (stock item becomes an asset)
description: When an asset kind-change document is posted (process BP-ASSETS-07), the stock module's handler writes the negative stock leg (cause kind_change_out) in the same transaction as the asset entry, with the same correlation id.

actors.permission: TENANT_ADMIN task role (assets_kind_change/post has no required_permission)

preconditions: an issued assets kind_change document
stock at the from side
refusals: post_document refuses the kind_change_out cause; the stock ledger refuses a posting below zero unless allowed

tasks.result: the stock entry (-q per line at from) and the asset entry commit together or not at all

title: Crafted completion or start is refused (write targets) (security)
description: A caller who completes a post/reverse task with an output that overwrites a write target (document id, posting, mark ...), or starts a stock process by POST /instances with chosen initial_variables, is refused 422 output_refused (or answered as for an unknown definition) and nothing is written.
preconditions: a stock document issued with a pending Post task
refusals: 422 output_refused on a write-target key
module definitions start only from module code

tasks.result: completion with a write-target key in the body: 422 output_refused; POST /instances for a module definition: refused as unknown; balance and document unchanged

title: Cross-tenant read and write refused (security)
description: A token of tenant A used against tenant B's document, count or workbook-load id is answered with the same 404 as an unknown id, with B's row unchanged; no list of A holds B's rows; no route honours a tenant key from the caller.
preconditions: two tenants with the stock module and a real document in each
refusals: uniform 404 (INV-5)
a tenant key in the query is 422 invalid_filter

tasks.result: uniform 404 for every id route; the control call with the owner's token is not 404

title: Permission matrix per role of the stock area (security)
description: Each stock route is called by each role: the storekeeper may read, post, reverse, quick-count, count-order and count-record but not reconcile, apply a workbook or approve; the administrator may all; the auditor holds no stock permission at all (effective.golden: every Stock cell false); a role without the permission gets 403 (or 404 where the module guard applies).
preconditions: one user of each role in the tenant
refusals: 403 for a role without the permission

tasks.result: 403: StockReconcile, StockWorkbookApply and StockApprove are withheld from the storekeeper (approval-access answers that the caller does not hold it)
refused for reads and writes alike: the auditor holds no stock permission

title: Token and host lookup (security)
description: A wrong, expired, revoked or other tenant's token or shared-access value, or an unknown tenant slug/host, is refused with one uniform 401 (no hint which part failed); repeated failures from one address end in 429; an API token on a document route gets the 404 of a tenant without the module.
preconditions: an active shared access and a revoked one
refusals: uniform 401
429 after repeated failures

tasks.result: 401 identical for wrong value, revoked value, unlisted slug and other tenant's value; 429 when the failure bucket is empty; no tenant-dependent header

title: Upload types and limits (security)
description: The workbook check/apply takes only an .xlsx up to 2 MiB; voice audio only m4a or WebM up to 10 MB; the old-address body up to 8192 bytes. Over-limit or wrong-type input is refused and nothing is written.
preconditions: none
refusals: 413 / 415 / 422 on limits

tasks.result: an oversized or non-xlsx body is refused; audio_too_large 413 / audio_format 415; no record, entry or number written

title: Old-address access refused (security)
description: The shared access reaches only its six calls: no task, approval, count, import or user route; a path outside them (also /api/api/...) is 404 after authentication; while scope enforcement is on or shadow it is 403.
preconditions: an active shared access
refusals: 404 outside the six calls
403 scope_enforcement_active

tasks.result: other routes 404; /voice without /api is 404; scope_enforcement_active 403

title: Voice and typed-draft inputs (security)
description: Voice input is untrusted text: the draft only proposes items and places from the caller's own active masters and stores nothing; unknown fields and languages are refused.
preconditions: speech/model providers off or on
refusals: 422 field_not_allowed / bad_language

tasks.result: a phrase naming an item or place outside the caller's masters yields no such id; field_not_allowed / bad_language 422; nothing stored

title: Approval and separation of duties (security)
description: The person who prepared an opening or a quick count cannot approve it while the four-eyes rule is ON; the storekeeper never holds StockApprove, so a post, approve or reverse task addressed or reassigned to a storekeeper is still refused on claim and completion; switching four-eyes OFF does not grant StockApprove.
preconditions: four-eyes ON for stock_opening/approve and stock_quick_count/approve
refusals: refused for the preparer and for a role without StockApprove

tasks.result: claim or completion of an approve/post task by the preparer or by a storekeeper is refused; nothing is written
